notes.title: Special announcement: stepbystep release
notes.content:
My new game stepbystep is released, you can check it out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/972940/stepbystep/]here[/url]

It is a turn-based programming puzzle platformer, hope you will enjoy!

notes.title: Special announcement 2: stepbystep
notes.content:
The development of stepbystep is finished and the game will be available on November 22.
stepbystep is a minimalistic programming puzzle platformer with experimental turn-based mechanics where you must write a command sequence to complete the leves that will be run automatically. 

Steam store page: [url=store.steampowered.com/app/972940/stepbystep]stepbystep[/url]

Hope you will enjoy.

notes.title: Special announcement: stepbystep
notes.content:
I'm working on a new game, this time it's a turn-based programming puzzle platformer called stepbystep. The game is planned to be released this December.

You can follow me on [url=twitter.com/fiddenmar]twitter[/url] to see development progress and gameplay.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018110/6fb4b0c6a967b4605f9cae58ecb19a47b9851d51.gif[/img]

Hope you will enjoy and thank you for playing.
